title: Google Fitbit Edge ve Flo Health ortaklığı duyuruldu
summary: Google, aktif yaşam tarzları için tasarlanan yeni akıllı saati Fitbit Edge'i ve kadın sağlığı için Flo Health ile yapılan stratejik ortaklığı duyurdu.
body:
Google, sağlık teknolojilerini günlük yaşama entegre etme hedefi doğrultusunda yeni **Fitbit Edge** modelini ve bir dizi yazılım yeniliğini duyurdu. Fitbit Air ve Pixel Watch 5 modelleri arasında konumlanan yeni akıllı saat, kullanıcılara anlık rehberlik sunmak ve Google Health Coach için bilekten erişim sağlamak amacıyla tasarlandı. Yapılan güncellemeler kapsamında Fitbit Air için pasif kardiyometabolik trend takibi ve yeni metal örgü kayış seçenekleri de kullanıcılara sunuluyor.

## Kadın sağlığında Flo Health iş birliği

Google, kadın sağlığı alanındaki çalışmalarını genişletmek amacıyla dünyanın önde gelen kadın sağlığı platformu **Flo Health** ile uzun vadeli stratejik bir ortaklık başlattı. Yapılan anlaşma sayesinde, önümüzdeki yılın başından itibaren kullanıcılar Flo Health uygulamalarını Google Health ile güvenli ve onay tabanlı olarak senkronize edebilecek. Bu entegrasyon ile döngü, gebelik ve menopoz verileri; uyku, dinlenme kalp atış hızı ve aktivite metrikleriyle birleştirilerek Google Health Coach üzerinden kişiselleştirilmiş rehberlik sunulmasında kullanılacak.

## Yeni iş birlikleri ve ekosistem güncellemeleri

Google Health ekosistemi, NBA şampiyonu Stephen Curry'nin resmi Performans Danışmanı olarak katılmasıyla genişliyor. Curry'nin yanı sıra Bryson DeChambeau, JuJu Watkins, Chari Hawkins, Sophia Wilson, Alex Cooper, MrBeast, Jess Sims ve Kylie Sakaida gibi sporcu, içerik üretici ve uzmanlar da Google Health deneyimini geliştirmek için ekiple birlikte çalışacak.

**Neden önemli?** Google'ın duyurduğu yeni donanım ve stratejik ortaklıklar, sağlık teknolojilerinin kişiselleştirilmiş bir günlük yaşam arkadaşına dönüştürülmesi sürecinde önemli bir adım oluşturuyor.

source_texts.title: Google Health: Evolving so you can focus on living better
source_texts.summary: What’s new from Google Health: Explore the new Fitbit Edge, expanded workout tracking, and dedicated women's health insights.
source_texts.text:
When we introduced the new Google Health app, Health Coach, and Fitbit Air just a few months ago, we set out on an ambitious journey: to shift health technology from a fragmented, reactive data-tracking ecosystem to a proactive, personalized companion for your everyday life.
The response has been incredible, with Fitbit Air capturing new users’ attention and drawing new audiences into Google Health. But that was just the beginning. We knew we’d need to continuously improve and innovate to make our app and personalized coaching as meaningful and helpful as possible. Over the past few months, we’ve focused on listening closely to feedback, relentlessly iterating with 10 releases and 55 feature updates to make our experiences better over time.
We know that true progress happens in the rhythm of daily life: meeting you where you are, adapting to your routine, and continuously improving. Today, we’re taking our next step forward across our devices, software, and ecosystem.
Introducing Google Fitbit Edge: A deliberate step change in design and performance. Sitting between the lightweight simplicity of Fitbit Air and the power of Pixel Watch 5, Fitbit Edge is built for active lifestyles, offering glanceable, real-time guidance and serving as an on-wrist window to the Google Health Coach.
Improving Fitbit Air: From bringing passive cardiometabolic trend tracking with Health Guardian features to innovating our activity detection accuracy for 100+ workouts, we're making our tracker experiences smarter, more proactive, and deeply integrated across our platform to do the thinking so you don’t have to. New Metal Mesh Fitbit Air bands expand the styling possibilities, transforming your everyday tracker into elegant jewelry.
Making a leap forward for women’s health: Recognizing that health looks different across every body and life stage, we’re partnering with Flo Health — the world’s leading female health app — to integrate deeply important cycle, pregnancy, and menopause guidance directly into our app and Coach, alongside groundbreaking research in this underserved and often-generalized population.
Welcoming world-class talent to Google Health: We’re welcoming exceptional new leaders, researchers, and builders to join Performance Advisor Stephen Curry on the Google Health team to accelerate our mission and push the boundaries of what health technology can do.
Health is complex, personal, and deeply human. We don’t have all the answers, but we are committed to showing up every day, learning from you, and continuously refining our tools to help you live a longer, healthier life.

source_texts.title: From game days to daily life: The familiar faces teaming up with Google Health
source_texts.summary: See the athletes, creators, and wellness experts who are using Google Health to help make our technology better for everyone.
source_texts.text:
From game days to daily life: The familiar faces teaming up with Google Health
We’ve teamed up with some of the most accomplished athletes, creators, and wellness experts to help shape the new Google Health experience. From an NBA champion and an Olympic heptathlete to a registered dietitian and a YouTube creator, here’s a look at how this dynamic group is putting Google Health app, Google Health Coach, and Fitbit wearables to work in their daily lives. Plus, how their feedback makes our health technology more intuitive, personalized, and helpful for everyone.
The game changers
- Stephen Curry: As our official Performance Advisor for Google Health, Stephen brings his natural tech curiosity straight to our product teams. Stephen and his trainers work hands-on with our engineers to test coaching built with Gemini with live biometric data, co-design hardware, and turn complex athletic insights into simple tips for daily life.
- Bryson DeChambeau: Known for his obsession with biomechanics, Bryson pairs his analytical mindset with our health teams. He inputs his off-course training, rest, and energy burn metrics into Google’s algorithms to help fine-tune personalized Google Health Coach insights.
- JuJu Watkins: JuJu balances college classes, brand commitments, community foundations, and team ownership with Boston Legacy FC. As she works her way back on the court post injury, JuJu is using Google Health Coach to keep her sleep, nutrition, and recovery steady even with an unpredictable schedule.
- Chari Hawkins: For an Olympic heptathlete, precision is everything. Chari uses Google Health Coach to monitor her fitness, recovery, and women's health insights, showing how everyday athletes can use the same data-driven tools to hit their own goals.
- Sophia Wilson: Juggling life as a pro soccer player for the Portland Thorns FC and the U.S. women's national soccer team, plus life with a toddler, Sophia relies on Google Health Coach to keep tabs on her nutrition and log her meals as she navigates returning to the pitch.
The culture shapers
- Alex Cooper: Through her Unwell network, Alex brings candid conversations to millions every week. Now, she is teaming up with Google Health to show how tools like Google Health Coach can help her community build sustainable daily routines, prioritize recovery, and hit their wellness goals. Alex also works with our teams to weave products like Pixel, Gemini, and Google Cloud into her workflow, making health and tech feel approachable and fun.
- MrBeast: MrBeast is adopting Google Health tools as his go-to resources for fitness and recovery. He is weaving the Google Health Coach into his challenges, most recently his Grocery store challenge, and collaborating with our team on an exciting new initiative launching next year.
The daily motivators
- Jess Sims: The Peloton instructor is bringing her "You don't have to, you get to" philosophy to help users build balanced, sustainable routines. With an emphasis on progress over perfection, she shows how Fitbit and Google Health Coach connect the dots across sleep, cycle phases, and recovery to help everyone feel their best.
- Kylie Sakaida: The NYT best-selling cookbook author and registered dietitian uses Google Health app and Google Health Coach to share stress-free nutrition tips, proving wellness tools are built for everyday meals, not just elite training plans.
Whether you are training for a championship or simply trying to get an extra hour of sleep, Google Health is built to help you build habits that fit your life.

source_texts.title: We’re partnering with Flo Health to elevate women’s health
source_texts.summary: Google Health announces new partnership and deeper commitment to women’s health with Flo Health.
source_texts.text:
We’re partnering with Flo Health to elevate women’s health
A truly personalized health experience starts with understanding the unique rhythms of your body. With Google Health Coach, 1 we’re building a personal health experience that adapts to your lifestyle, habits, and biology — which is especially important for women. Connecting the dots across sleep, daily readiness, activity, and recovery gives a clearer picture of your overall health across the different phases of your cycle and stages of life. That is why we make it easy to log your cycle dates and symptoms, or quickly view period predictions and cycle phases — either on-wrist with Fitbit Edge or in the Google Health app. And with Google Health Premium, you can receive tailored, cycle-aware coaching, too. 2
As part of our long-term commitment to invest in and support women's health, we’re launching a landmark, multi-year strategic partnership with Flo Health, the world's leading female health platform used by more than 80 million women every month. This collaboration will help build a cohesive, empowering experience to manage daily health. Plus, we'll partner on initiatives that further women's health.
A multi-year vision for tailored guidance
Because your body goes through complex phases throughout the month and major shifts throughout life, health insights must continuously adapt. Google Health aims to give you a complete view of your overall wellbeing across all phases and stages of life — from periods to pregnancy to perimenopause. When you wear a smartwatch or tracker 24/7, like the Google Fitbit Air , Pixel Watch 5, or all new Google Fitbit Edge, you capture the continuous, night-over-night biometric data needed to truly understand these shifts.
Our collaboration with Flo Health will focus on four central pillars:
- Secure, consent-based app syncing: Beginning early next year, you will be able to easily sync your Flo Health app with Google Health. With your consent, your cycle data from Flo Health can be linked with your Google Health metrics (e.g. resting heart rate, heart rate variability, skin temperature, and sleep stages) to give you one clear picture of your day. Similarly, the data from your Google Health app will be made available to Flo for a deeper, more personalized, and consistent experience between apps.
- Google Health Coach integration: 3 Flo Health data will integrate with your Google Health Coach. Whether you’re navigating cycle health or managing perimenopause, with Google Health Premium your coach will connect the dots across your cycle, sleep, and recovery to give you tailored, actionable guidance.
- Ground-breaking women’s health research: We plan to partner on dedicated research initiatives spanning underserved topics — this may include perimenopause, polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS), pregnancy, and postpartum recovery.
- New products: We will partner to build new products that are specifically designed for women, with a deep integration of Flo's women's health insights and algorithms with our expertise in wearable hardware and advanced sensors.
Built with uncompromising privacy and expertise
We recognize that women’s health data is deeply personal. Your trust is our top priority, which is why this entire experience is built on a strict, transparent opt-in model.
Flo Health and Google Health are committed to data privacy and security, and a crucial part of this partnership is ensuring women stay in control. No data will move between the apps without your explicit permission — given separately for each type of data and each purpose — and you have the control to withdraw permission at any time. Flo data shared with Google Health will never be used for advertising, never be sold, and will not be made available to other apps or developers through Google's health platforms.
We are eager to bring thoughtful, innovative experiences to women at every stage of their health journey. This is just the beginning of a long-term partnership to make personalized health guidance a daily reality.
